name: Changelog
description: Release notes grouped by date, each change tagged New, Improved or Fixed.
notes: Lead with what changed for the user, not the ticket title. Dates are machine-readable <time> elements so feeds and search engines understand them.
checked: axe clean in light and dark; tightest text contrast 4.79:1 (needs 4.5:1); 0 tab stops; fits a phone in RTL with Arabic: yes; with 40% longer text: yes; contrast holds with a fitted brand: yes

20 Nov 2026

Version 3.2

  • New Split by percentage, not just shares.
  • Improved Receipts load twice as fast on slow connections.
  • Fixed Totals no longer round the wrong way in yen.
28 Oct 2026

Version 3.1

  • New Dark mode follows your system setting.
  • Fixed Guests can now attach photos.
